design.name: 镇岳 (one-horned rhinoceros guardian, 兕)
design.role: 坦克：裂地重击 / 磐石壁垒 / 厚皮
design.brief: A massive anthropomorphic ancient Chinese ONE-HORNED RHINOCEROS (兕) guardian, the tank. Huge rounded slate-grey hide with thick carved skin folds, one big curved horn, small ears, small calm determined eyes, a broad jaw. Enormous shoulders and forearms, short sturdy legs, three-toed elephant-like feet in bronze-capped sandal boots. Wears Warring-States lacquered rhino-hide lamellar armour (犀甲): black lacquer plates with verdigris-jade cloud patterns and bronze rivets, a big bronze taotie belt buckle, a short heavy skirt of lamellar strips. His LEFT forearm is encased in a huge bronze gauntlet-bracer shaped like a mountain (built into the armour, not a held shield) with cracks glowing warm amber spirit fire. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four separate thick fingers.
design.weapon: a heavy short-barrelled bronze blunderbuss shotgun held in the right hand, the left bronze gauntlet raised mid ground-slam with amber cracks blazing
design.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing A-pose for rigging: arms held about 40 degrees away from the body with straight elbows, both hands open, flat and EMPTY (no gun, no grenade, no weapons anywhere), legs straight and slightly apart, mouth closed, calm expression
design.turnaround_pose: , the bronze mountain gauntlet on the LEFT forearm with its amber cracks glowing softly (no sparks or effects around it), the short tail hanging down at the back
design.turnaround_digits: each hand open with a separate thumb and four separate slightly spread thick fingers, each foot with three bronze-capped toes clearly shown.
